F.No.66-1/2026-PW/
अण्डमान तथा निकोबार प्रशासन
ANDAMAN AND NICOBAR ADMINISTRATION
सचिवालय /SECRETARIAT
****
Sri Vijay Puram, dated 09th September, 2026

To
All Heads of Departments/Offices,
A&N Administration.

Sub: - Circulation of provisional seniority list of LGCs of Amalgamated Clerical
Cadre for filing of claims & objections, if any - regarding.

I am directed to forward herewith Provisional Seniority List of Lower Grade
Clerks of AC Cadre of this Administration, with the request to circulate the same
amongst the LGCs working in your department/ establishment including those who
have been posted in subordinate and out station offices, and claim and objections, if
any, received from them, may be forwarded to the Administration immediately but not
later than 21/09/2026.

A compliance report regarding circulation of the provisional seniority list
amongst the concerned LGCs of your dept. / office may be furnished to this
Administration within the aforesaid period and in case no representation is received
from any of the LGCs working in the office the same may also be confirmed by the
date indicated above.

Yours faithfully
(K. Ajit Kumar)
Deputy Secretary (Perl.)

Copy together with copy of enclosure is also forwarded to all Section in the Secretariat
for similar necessary action.
